title: Washing away postdecisional dissonance.
central_claims: Hand washing eliminates postdecisional preference spreading in a choice task.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: The washing manipulation did not reduce preference spreading: r=-.046, p=.436, N=286. An acknowledged album-order protocol deviation leaves a material construct-validity uncertainty.
